timeline.title: Baseline experiment gate: no adapter until direct API failure is demonstrated
timeline.detail: Design-only decision proposal: first execute the isolated direct-API lost-acknowledgment fixture without Mycelium. Gate A requires stable operation identity, destination-authoritative lookup with explicit coverage, one committed effect, zero duplicate effects and a recorded indeterminate outcome whenever coverage is missing. Only if Gate A demonstrably fails a stated non-negotiable requirement should an optional adapter enter Gate B; compare with identical fault seeds and require no new authority or dependency for BuildWise. This avoids treating adapter complexity as a foregone conclusion. Owen review pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Minimal authoritative oracle for first fault-injection trial
timeline.detail: Design-only test oracle for the first lost-acknowledgment fixture: pre-register a stable synthetic operation ID, record destination committed-effect count and authoritative lookup coverage separately, then compare direct-API and optional-adapter arms against the same fault schedule. A lookup timeout or missing coverage is indeterminate, not not-seen; retry remains blocked until destination evidence resolves the outcome. A trial passes only if committed effects equal one, duplicate commits equal zero, and BuildWise remains independently reachable when the adapter is stopped. This is a specification, not executed evidence; Owen review pending.

timeline.title: First executable baseline fixture: lost acknowledgment without duplicate effect
timeline.detail: Design-only prototype specification, not executed: use three isolated synthetic nodes representing BuildWise authority, ContextWise observer and Android client. At t=0 submit operation O1 with stable ID; at t=1 destination records one committed effect; at t=2 drop its acknowledgment; at t=3 disconnect Android for 30 seconds; at t=33 reconnect and query destination outcome by O1 before any resend. Run paired direct-API and optional-adapter arms with identical scripted events and clean resets. Independent oracle must observe exactly one effect, no automatic second mutation, explicit indeterminate if outcome lookup lacks coverage, and no dependency on the adapter for direct BuildWise operation. Log only aggregate outcome classes and timing. Owen review pending; no experiment or model job executed.

timeline.title: Architecture decision backlog: evidence-first review gate
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: consolidate overlapping pending safety controls into four review gates: (1) baseline direct-API three-node fault trial, (2) authoritative operation identity and revocation, (3) discovery generation and ownership consistency, (4) optional telemetry and advisory Gemma 2 roles. Require each gate to name an owner, falsifiable acceptance criterion, evidence artifact and prerequisite; do not mark any proposal accepted or add runtime features solely because it was documented. Owen should first challenge whether a thin adapter is needed at all. No experiment executed; review pending.

timeline.title: Atomic discovery snapshots prevent mixed-generation capability views
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: a discovery refresh must publish a complete, generation-consistent read-only capability snapshot, never a partial blend of old and new advertisements. Stage updates privately, validate generation and withdrawal coverage, then atomically expose the snapshot; on timeout or conflict retain the last known view marked stale/unknown, with no mutation eligibility inferred. Synthetic three-node test interrupts refresh between capability records and injects out-of-order withdrawal; independent oracle requires zero mixed-generation active views, zero unauthorized operations, visible stale-state indicators and unaffected direct BuildWise operations. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Discovery tombstones prevent retired capabilities reappearing
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: when a Wise service retires an instance or capability, publish an authenticated generation-scoped withdrawal with bounded retention and monotonically increasing generation. Late advertisements from older generations remain visible as stale evidence but cannot re-enter the active capability view or authorize operations. Synthetic three-node test injects delayed adverts, Android reinstall, clock skew, rollback, and tombstone expiry; deterministic oracle requires zero retired-capability activations, explicit unknown state after incomplete evidence, and unaffected direct BuildWise operations. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Split-brain service ownership must not elect mutation authority
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: simulate two concurrently reachable instances advertising the same service capability after a partition or failover. Discovery records both authenticated claims without selecting a mutation leader; only the destination's authoritative monotonically fenced ownership epoch can establish which instance may accept writes. Stale or ambiguous epochs remain read-only/unknown. Compare direct authenticated API against optional adapter with identical split-brain fault seeds. Deterministic checker requires zero dual-writer commits, zero authority inferred from discovery, explicit ambiguity reporting, and continued independent BuildWise operation. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Evidence-retention expiry must block unsafe replay
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: model destination operation receipts with a retention horizon and explicit coverage watermark. Inject offline requests, lost acknowledgments, compaction and failover across identical direct-API and optional-adapter synthetic trials. When outcome evidence expires or the watermark cannot prove full coverage, classify the request indeterminate; never infer non-execution or replay a mutation. Independent checker requires zero duplicate effects, zero false not-seen classifications, and visible reconciliation-blocked counts. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Trace correlation must not imply authority or completeness
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: assign an opaque correlation ID to each synthetic request across direct API and optional adapter; keep it separate from destination-issued operation identity and capability grants. Observers record span counts, evidence age and explicit completeness (complete, partial, unknown), never treating missing spans as successful execution or as proof of non-execution. Test drops, reorders and duplicates 30% of optional telemetry while retaining destination audit evidence; independent oracle requires identical authoritative outcomes, zero privilege from correlation IDs, and visible trace incompleteness. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Telemetry backpressure must not become control-plane backpressure
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: isolate optional Mycelium telemetry from BuildWise command execution with a bounded queue, rate limits and aggregate drop counters. When observers lag or disconnect, shed noncritical metrics, report evidence gaps as unknown and preserve destination-side authoritative audit records. Synthetic three-node test saturates telemetry for 10 minutes while issuing authenticated direct-API commands; require unchanged command correctness, zero duplicate or unauthorized effects, bounded adapter memory, visible loss counters and BuildWise availability during adapter failure. Owen critique pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Capability revocation race test proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: test a revocation arriving between request admission and destination commit. A discovered or cached grant cannot authorize a mutation; destination authority must atomically validate capability validity and operation identity at the commit boundary. Synthetic trial varies revocation ordering, delayed messages and duplicate requests across direct-API and optional-adapter arms. Independent checker requires zero post-revocation commits when revocation precedes the commit gate, at most one effect per operation, explicit indeterminate classification when ordering cannot be proven, and no adapter-dependent BuildWise outage. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Health-state hysteresis and recovery eligibility separated
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: separate displayed service health from permission to resume mutations. After a partition, one fresh heartbeat may move unknown to degraded but cannot restore mutation eligibility. Require two independent fresh authenticated observations separated by a bounded stabilization interval plus destination-side capability revalidation; any contradictory evidence resets the stabilization window. Synthetic test injects alternating fresh/stale heartbeats, spoofed recovery notices and rapid flapping; checker requires zero automatic mutation eligibility from telemetry alone, no healthy/unhealthy oscillation on single samples, and BuildWise independent operation. Owen critique pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Recovery budgets must survive rediscovery and service identity changes
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: a reconnecting service cannot evade its rolling recovery budget by changing advertised names, endpoints, or instance identifiers. Charge attempts to a verified service identity plus failure domain; when identity cannot be verified, remain read-only and do not perform automatic recovery mutations. Synthetic test rotates aliases during a partition and simulates concurrent observers; independent checker requires no more than five recovery attempts per service per ten minutes, zero unauthorized mutations, and continued independent BuildWise operation. Owen critique pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Deterministic operation-outcome oracle specified
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: for each synthetic request, record a stable operation identity and classify its outcome as not-seen, admitted, committed, rejected or indeterminate using destination-side evidence. A missing acknowledgment never proves not-seen; indeterminate outcomes require read-only reconciliation, never blind retry. Compare direct API and optional adapter with identical fault seeds; independent oracle fails either arm on unauthorized effects, more than one committed effect per operation, or false terminal classification. Owen review pending; no experiment run.

timeline.title: Four-state health evidence model proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: report healthy, degraded, unreachable, and unknown separately for every discovered Wise service. Each status records an evidence age and source class; stale telemetry becomes unknown rather than healthy or failed, and adapter failure cannot be presented as BuildWise failure. Synthetic test injects delayed heartbeat, missing telemetry, partition, recovered connection and adapter outage; deterministic checker requires zero false healthy claims, zero adapter-caused BuildWise failure classifications and clear unknown status. Owen review pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Gemma 2 advisory-only experiment role proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: local Gemma 2 reviewers may generate objections and test cases from sanitized synthetic fixtures but cannot authorize, route, recover, or grade service mutations. A deterministic independent oracle decides all pass/fail gates; blank, conflicting or unavailable model output is recorded as no review, not consensus. Synthetic test injects persuasive incorrect recommendations, blank replies and conflicting reviewer votes; require zero effect on operation authority or test outcomes. Owen review pending; no model job or test executed.

timeline.title: Discovery convergence versus trust separation test proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only synthetic test: three nodes publish conflicting and delayed capability advertisements during partition and reconnection. Compare direct authenticated API discovery to the optional adapter using identical fault seeds. Measure time to a consistent read-only service view separately from authenticated authorization; require zero mutations authorized by discovery alone, stale or forged advertisements flagged rather than silently trusted, and BuildWise operation independent of adapter availability. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Adapter-only outage negative control proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only addition to the paired three-node trial: inject an outage of the optional Mycelium adapter while direct BuildWise APIs remain healthy. Existing authorized operations must continue directly; pending adapter requests must report unknown rather than replaying mutations, and observability must distinguish adapter outage from destination failure. Compare to direct-API baseline with identical request fixtures; reject the adapter if it creates a new single point of failure. Owen review pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Paired fault-test reproducibility protocol proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: run direct-API baseline and optional thin-adapter trial against the same versioned synthetic request fixture, deterministic fault seed, capability grants, and independent outcome oracle. Reset simulated node state between arms; repeat at least 10 seeds, compare paired outcome classes and recovery latency, and reject any result with unmatched conditions or oracle disagreement. Capture aggregate metrics only. This prevents apparent adapter gains caused by easier test conditions. Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Falsifiable minimum-architecture decision gate proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: freeze new Mycelium runtime features pending a paired three-node trial. Run identical deterministic fault scripts first with direct authenticated APIs and then with a thin optional adapter; compare recovery time, unauthorized or duplicate mutations, unknown outcomes, retry count and added operational dependencies. Adopt an adapter only if it measurably improves recovery or observability without increasing mutation authority or impairing direct BuildWise operation. If baseline passes, keep Mycelium as a capability contract and dashboard rather than a new broker. Owen critique pending; no experiment executed.

timeline.title: Recovery dependency-cycle containment proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: model each service adapter's recovery prerequisites as a directed graph, reject cycles that include an automated restart or authorization dependency, and cap concurrent recovery actions per failure domain. When discovery, identity, or telemetry dependencies fail together, retain read-only degraded status and require external evidence before restoring mutation capability. Synthetic test injects a three-service dependency cycle, common network partition and simultaneous restart; pass requires zero recursive restart storms, no unauthorized writes, and independent BuildWise availability. Owen critique pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Three-node reuse-first experiment acceptance gates proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only experiment: compare direct authenticated APIs with a thin optional adapter across BuildWise, ContextWise and a simulated Android endpoint. Inject 30-second disconnect, duplicate delivery, stale capability manifest, revoked authority and 10-minute Android suspension. Require zero unauthorized or duplicate mutations, BuildWise jobs still operable without Mycelium, recovery attempts bounded to five per service per 10 minutes, and explicit unknown outcomes rather than automatic replay. Capture only aggregate latency, retry counts and outcome classes. This is a proposed gate, not a completed test; Owen review pending.

timeline.title: Capability-contract compatibility gate proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: discovery provides a capability manifest with protocol version, operation class (read-only versus mutation), and contract digest. The requester must verify a mutually supported contract before invoking an operation; unknown versions or digest mismatches remain visible for diagnostics but cannot execute mutations. Synthetic test mixes old/new Android, BuildWise and ContextWise adapters, forged capability advertisements, rolling upgrades and rollback; pass requires zero incompatible mutations, explicit downgrade refusal and no loss of read-only observability. Pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Reuse-first Mycelium architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Owner challenged whether Mycelium duplicates routers and existing integration tools. Proposed reuse-first decision: retain BuildWise job authority and ContextWise memory; use standard networking, authenticated APIs and existing message transport rather than inventing a router, broker or orchestration engine. Build only capability contracts and adapters when an end-to-end three-node experiment demonstrates an unmet need. Pending Owen review; no prototype run or deployment.

timeline.title: Per-service bounded recovery budget proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: discovery and transport retries use per-service exponential backoff with jitter, a rolling attempt budget, and a quarantine state after exhaustion. Authentication or revoked-capability failures are never treated as transient transport errors and cannot trigger automatic reauthorization. Quarantined services remain visible for diagnostics; read-only health probes are rate-limited, and recovery requires fresh authenticated evidence before writes resume. Synthetic test injects flapping endpoints, partition healing, revoked grants and simultaneous node restarts; pass requires bounded retries, no unauthorized effects and no synchronized retry storm. Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Single-writer BuildWise adapter contract proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only boundary: Mycelium routes opaque, correlation-tagged requests and status envelopes but stores no authoritative task or approval state. BuildWise alone assigns job IDs, validates approval and records terminal outcomes; Android holds only a disposable local outbox. Synthetic partition test injects duplicate delivery, reorder, offline reconnect and Mycelium restart; pass requires one BuildWise job per idempotency key, zero transport-authorized mutations, and direct BuildWise operation during Mycelium outage. Owen critique pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Phone approval as intent, not reusable authority
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: a direct Android-to-BuildWise approval carries an immutable job reference, action digest, intended actor, expiry and single-use challenge. BuildWise remains the authoritative approval ledger and revalidates job version and authorization immediately before execution; offline, stale, altered or replayed approvals cannot authorize mutations. Synthetic test covers delayed delivery, duplicate tap, changed job parameters, expired challenge and revoked approval; pass requires zero unauthorized executions and one auditable decision per challenge. Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: BuildWise ownership boundary and Tasker retirement path proposed
timeline.detail: Owner-directed design: BuildWise remains the authoritative development-task, agent, approval and execution engine; Mycelium provides discovery, authenticated transport and routing without duplicating job state. A direct Android-to-BuildWise inbox is proposed, with existing Tasker features inventoried and migrated selectively. Preserve independent BuildWise operation and use Mycelium as an optional transport. Design only; Riley controls implementation; Owen review pending; no deployment.

timeline.title: Discovery-versus-capability lifecycle separation proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: maintain separate discovered, authenticated, reachable and authorized states per Wise service. Discovery advertisements are untrusted hints, never grants; capability decisions require independently verified, audience-scoped, expiring authority and revocation freshness. On partition or stale revocation evidence, preserve read-only visibility but deny new mutations. Synthetic test injects spoofed discovery, identity rotation, revoked grants, stale caches and partition healing; pass only with zero unauthorized effects and deterministic recovery without service disappearance. Pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Admission receipt and crash-window matrix proposed
timeline.detail: Design-only proposal: distinguish pre-admission rejection, admitted-with-receipt, and admission-acknowledgment-lost states. Require a destination-issued stable operation identity and durable lookup before considering retry; unknown admission remains quarantined. Synthetic crash-window matrix tests before admission, after durable admission but before acknowledgment, after execution but before terminal acknowledgment, and during failover. Pass only with zero duplicate effects and zero unknown commands auto-replayed. Pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Command-admission boundary proof proposed
timeline.detail: A closure certificate or complete telemetry interval is not sufficient to prove non-execution after command admission. Propose explicit destination-owned admission identity and a three-stage synthetic state machine: rejected-before-admission, admitted-outcome-unknown, and terminal outcome. Only a destination-authenticated pre-admission rejection with closed intake evidence may establish non-execution; admitted but missing terminal evidence stays unknown and cannot be automatically replayed. Test lost admission acknowledgments, delayed commits, compaction and failover. Design-only, Owen review pending; no test executed.

timeline.title: Watermark provenance and retention-bound closure test proposed
timeline.detail: Propose a source-owned closure certificate binding operation ID, source generation, contiguous sequence interval, retention lower bound and snapshot checkpoint. Watermark advancement alone is insufficient to prove non-execution after compaction or failover. Synthetic test injects generation rollover, expired evidence, forged/stale watermarks and compaction gaps; require zero false authoritative-negative classifications and no automatic replay of unknown mutations. Proposal only, pending Owen review; no test executed.

timeline.title: Three-valued telemetry completeness proposal
timeline.detail: Propose separate observed-positive, authoritative-negative, and unknown evidence states. A source-owned monotonic completeness watermark plus event sequence and generation may close a gap only with verified provenance; missing or out-of-order telemetry remains unknown. Synthetic two-node test injects sequence gaps, replay, lost acknowledgment, partition, restart, and watermark regression. Pass only if zero unknown mutations are replayed and zero false-success decisions are accepted. Design-only, pending Owen review; no tests executed.

timeline.title: Causal observability contract proposed
timeline.detail: Propose a bounded, privacy-safe causal event envelope with correlation ID, component role, stage, outcome class, monotonic sequence and evidence reference. Discovery, authorization, reachability, recovery and inference must remain separate states. Simulate reordered, missing and duplicate events plus coordinator restart; require deterministic reconstruction without logging credentials or mistaking missing telemetry for permission to retry. Gemma 4 local workshop completed with empty final responses, so no model consensus is claimed. Proposal pending Owen review; no tests executed.

timeline.title: Reboot-safe executor identity test proposed
timeline.detail: Propose a synthetic executor identity tuple combining host boot generation, unique launch nonce and process start identity; PID alone is insufficient. After reboot or lease expiry, require independently verified exit/resource release before reopening a capacity-one inference slot. Inject PID reuse, stale heartbeats and delayed results; acceptance requires zero overlapping accepted probes and zero stale design votes. Pending Owen review; no tests executed.

timeline.title: Inference resource-slot fencing proposed after Owen ADR-013
timeline.detail: Separate logical lease ownership from actual executor resource occupancy. An expired probe with unverified exit remains orphaned and blocks replacement on a capacity-one host. Propose synthetic crash, cancellation, PID reuse, reboot and stale-result tests. Owen critique requested; tests not run.

timeline.title: Fenced inference recovery probe proposed after Owen ADR-012
timeline.detail: Following Owen's typed inference-outcome taxonomy, propose a synthetic SQLite compare-and-swap lease with generation fencing and unique probe identity. Concurrent coordinators, crashes, stale late results and duplicate delivery must not produce extra accepted probes or design votes. Proposed only; tests not run; Owen critique requested.

timeline.title: Inference attempt ledger and read-only probe proposed
timeline.detail: Following Owen's typed inference-envelope critique, propose a durable record of every model attempt and a separate read-only diagnostic lane. Empty model output never counts as design consensus. Synthetic test will inject two blank replies followed by a valid reply, checking one half-open probe, preserved state and zero automatic mutations. Pending Owen review; not implemented.

timeline.title: Inference health gate proposed; Owen discovery critique received
timeline.detail: Owen proposes separating discovery, authentication, reachability and authorization. A local Gemma 4 design-only experiment recorded empty responses despite an active process. Proposed synthetic adapter test rejects blank output, preserves durable chat, bounds model failure and keeps deterministic recovery independent. Pending review; no runtime fix or production deployment.

timeline.title: Evidence-expiry fail-closed rule proposed
timeline.detail: If a destination's operation-status retention expires before an uncertain command is reconciled, Mycelium must not infer failure or automatically retry. Preserve a durable unresolved record, require manual adjudication or independently authenticated proof, and test expiration across coordinator restart. Proposal pending Owen review; no real integration certified.

timeline.title: Evidence-based reconciliation gate proposed
timeline.detail: Proposed resolution contract: a pending external mutation can close as succeeded only with destination-authenticated positive evidence tied to the original operation ID; it can close as not-executed only with an explicit destination guarantee of authoritative absence covering the operation lifetime. Timeouts and ordinary NOT_FOUND remain unknown. Restart must preserve quarantine and forbid replay. Pending Owen review; no implementation.

timeline.title: Negative-read safety rule proposed
timeline.detail: A NOT_FOUND response from an eventually consistent destination is not proof a command failed. Proposed test injects commit + lost acknowledgment + stale negative read; gateway must quarantine the unknown effect, preserve the operation key across restart, and never replay without destination-backed proof. Pending Owen review; not implemented.

timeline.title: Unknown-effect state machine proposed
timeline.detail: Owen endorses read-only Tasker evidence dossier and synthetic remote U test. Proposed effect state machine holds uncertain external outcomes without automatic mutation replay, even after restart. Owen review requested; no real endpoint certified.

timeline.title: Endpoint evidence dossier and synthetic T boundary proposed
timeline.detail: Owen requires endpoint-specific proof before classifying retries as safe. Workshop nominates Tasker task creation for read-only contract examination, keeps it uncertain, and limits transactional prototype claims to synthetic SQLite tests. Android liveness targets remain provisional.

timeline.title: Adapter classes and Android liveness contract proposed
timeline.detail: Owen distinguishes transactional, provider-idempotent and uncertain external mutations. Workshop provisionally treats real Wise mutation APIs as uncertain until destination guarantees are verified; Android recovery must tolerate OS-delayed execution. No implementation.

timeline.title: Adapter gateway and uncertain effects proposed
timeline.detail: Owen identified that node epochs alone cannot fence operations. Proposed destination-side command validation, durable deduplication, and explicit reconciliation for nontransactional APIs. Under independent review; no implementation.

timeline.title: Partition-safe recovery policy proposed
timeline.detail: Separate service discovery from authorization. During network partitions, permit local observation but require fresh authorization before state-changing replay. Owen review requested; no implementation.

timeline.title: Owen review received; staged architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Owen recommends hybrid local cells and a durable relay. Workshop proposes starting with a simpler simulated broker test, then testing partition-tolerant cells. Both remain proposals; no implementation verified.

timeline.title: Public architecture observatory
timeline.detail: Shareable website and versioned public architecture feed initiated.

timeline.title: Hybrid architecture proposed
timeline.detail: Lightweight discovery registry, node agents, event transport, bounded self-repair.

timeline.title: Owen workshop initiated
timeline.detail: Owen accepted the workshop and submitted an independent architecture critique.
